name: Children Going To Heaven
overview: Scripture reveals that children, who may lack full knowledge of good and evil, are included in God's promises and inheritance, as seen in Deuteronomy 1:39. Jesus affirms the special place of children in the kingdom of heaven, inviting them to come to Him (Matthew 19:14). Salvation and entrance into heaven come through faith in Christ alone, who is the only way to the Father (John 14:6; John 5:24). Ultimately, God will remove all sorrow and death, offering eternal comfort and joy to His people (Revelation 21:4).
